title: Eastern-Style Lamb Shawarma
description: A twist on the classic Middle Eastern shawarma, this recipe incorporates Asian flavors from China to create a unique and savory dish.

ingredients.name: Eastern shawarma spice mix
ingredients.notes: Available in most Middle Eastern markets

ingredients.name: Middle eastern flatbread
ingredients.notes: Or substitute with Chinese scallion pancakes

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together shawarma spice mix, 2 tablespoons olive oil, and 2 cloves minced garlic.
Add lamb strips to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Let the lamb marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Remove the lamb from the marinade and cook in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until browned and cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast the flatbread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5-7 minutes.
Assemble the shawarma by slicing the cooked lamb and serving it on the toasted flatbread with shawarma sauce, scallions, and toasted sesame seeds.
Garnish with Chinese chives and serve immediately.
